company.guide: Guide: If you want to start with low capital, Car Wash, Internet Cafe, Textile Workshop or Restaurant work well. If you want higher daily profit, Hotel, Construction Company, Crypto Mining or Night Club are better, but their daily expenses are also higher. Car Dealership, Real Estate Office, Shipping Company and Supermarket Chain are balanced middle options. Every company automatically generates its own profit each day and raises its own credit score. You can have at most one company per province; but if you already have a company in a province, you can open additional companies in its districts (one per district). You can open as many companies as you like in different provinces. When you select a type from the list, that company's cost, expenses and profit range are shown below based on your current balance.
